characterQuestions.question: Every team needs different player types. Which one are you?

options.text: The one checking the guides before the mission starts
The one wandering off to explore
The one upgrading everything
The one that makes sure no one gets left behind

characterQuestions.question: You've just unlocked unlimited money. Be honest... what disappears first?

options.text: The inventory. I'm collecting everything
The map fog. I'm exploring everything
The starter house. I'm building a mansion
The original storyline. These characters are about to become very dramatic

characterQuestions.question: You find a legendary artefact that nobody has seen for centuries! Your first thought is...

options.text: I need to know how this works!
I wonder what other secrets I can find!
Imagine what I can make with this!
Who else can benefit from this discovery?

characterQuestions.question: You've inherited a neglected piece of land. What excites you most?

options.text: Unlock every secret, challenge and hidden reward
Explore caves, forests, and places off the beaten path
Transform it into something beautiful and thriving
Get to know the local community and build strong relationships

characterQuestions.question: You reach the final boss battle. The kingdom needs you. What do you do?

options.text: Study the boss' patterns and uncover its weaknesses
Explore the area looking for hidden paths
Craft a weapon to gain an advantage
Rally your team and lead everyone into victory
